title: Odd BLR Acceptance Fourier Formula
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f$ map the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ to $\\{ -1,1 \\}$. The acceptance probability of the odd BLR test on $f$ is $\\frac12+\\frac12\\sum_{S\\subseteq[n],\,|S|\\text{ odd}}\\widehat f(S)^3$, where $\\widehat f(S)$ is the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
